name: builder
description: A dependency-free build pipeline for any repo. Explores the idea first (brainstorm) or verifies a worked-out spec against the code (intake), sizes the confirmed concept (xs/sm in chat, md/lg as a SPEC + manifest through its own subagent task loop, xl as a program), then drives spec → align → audit → plan → build → the human walk → signoff → verify → ship, resumable after any /clear from a ~12-line MANIFEST.md. Multi-app aware: every app gets a §Apps row, the contract freezes when the producer's phase verifies, and phases run one app at a time. Reads every project fact from one host file, .claude/builder.md. Entry: /builder:brainstorm, or /builder:intake for a written spec. Resume: /builder:resume. Help: /builder:help.
